visual_review: Before was a compact glyph with zigzag fins (unreadable). Redrawn from the reference's top view: outlined hammer bar across the top, long body curving down and right like a J into a forked tail, pectoral fins as strokes sweeping back from each flank. VRECT_L. Valid, gate pass.
